description: Choose a mode, a league, and a date, season, week, team, or event IDs. The actor reads ESPN's public JSON endpoints without credentials or proxy setup.

date.description: A day (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD), a month (YYYY-MM), or a year (YYYY). Leave empty to use today, or use Season / Week instead. (mode=scoreboard, schedule, odds, gameDetail)
date.title: Date

endDate.description: Last day of a custom window (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD). Maximum 366 days. (mode=scoreboard, schedule, odds, gameDetail)
endDate.title: End date

eventIds.description: ESPN event IDs for game detail or odds, for example 401585183. Leave empty to discover games from the date or season. (mode=odds, gameDetail)
eventIds.title: Event IDs

includeDetails.description: Add leaders, odds, attendance, officials, article text, team stats, player stats and injuries to each game. (mode=scoreboard, schedule)
includeDetails.title: Include game details

league.description: Competition to read. Choose All supported leagues only with a specific sport when you need broad coverage. Defaults to NBA when omitted.
league.title: League

maxItems.description: Hard cap on records returned across all selected leagues.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

mode.description: What to return: games for a scoreboard, a schedule, the league team directory, one record per sportsbook odds line, or a full game detail record.
mode.title: Mode

season.description: ESPN season year, for example 2024. Use it with Week for a single football week, or alone for the whole season. (mode=scoreboard, schedule, odds, gameDetail)
season.title: Season

seasonType.description: Which part of the season to read when Season is set. (mode=scoreboard, schedule, odds, gameDetail)
seasonType.title: Season type

sport.description: Optional sport filter. Use it with League = All supported leagues to cover every supported competition in one sport.
sport.title: Sport

startDate.description: First day of a custom window (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD). Requires End date. (mode=scoreboard, schedule, odds, gameDetail)
startDate.title: Start date

status.description: Keep only games in this state. Postponed and cancelled games are reported as their own values.
status.title: Game status

team.description: Keep only games or teams matching this ESPN team ID, abbreviation, or name, for example 13, LAL, or Lakers. Prefix with a league code to disambiguate: nba:LAL. (mode=scoreboard, schedule, teams, odds, gameDetail)
team.title: Team

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for today/yesterday/tomorrow and for dateLocal, for example America/New_York.
timezone.title: Timezone

week.description: Week number for football and other week-based competitions. Requires Season. (mode=scoreboard, schedule, odds, gameDetail)
week.title: Week

title: ESPN Scores & Schedules Input
